text:
This is picture is of Saigon because that is a Saigon Taxi. Not sure what the building is but I would guess it's a restaurant hotel.

---

One time in Saigon, I was on a bar on a roof with Zukowski, Stanton and there was war going on all around us. It was one of my last days in Saigon. 

--
Stanton is from New York. One time Stanton came into my machine shop in LA in western Blvd and we went into King Henry the 8th topless club to eat.
researchNotes: Cataloged on VN-0081. Makes Stanton a real man — New York, a post-war visit to Larry's Los Angeles machine shop — and adds a rooftop bar with Zukowski in his last Saigon days, undated.
